metadata.description: Minimal reproducible Python/Java/C++ example targets for the artifact package.
notes: prebuilt_seed_base64 is used in prebuilt example mode
switch to --mode llm to use live model generation
embedded snippets allow prompt generation even when source files are not mounted locally
java/cpp use the standard oss-fuzz layout under <repo-root>/oss-fuzz
python uses bundled test scripts under tools/python_tests/
python uses a fixed-version interpreter and direct test files instead of docker coverage runners

targets.agent_context_snippet:
Repository context for sqlparse:
- Entry point: sqlparse.parse
- The parser calls FilterStack.run and grouping.group before reaching sqlparse.utils.imt.
- The target is in utils.py and evaluates token type / match predicates.
- Inputs should be compact SQL strings that produce real parsed token streams.

Repository context for jsoup:
- Driver: HtmlFuzzer.fuzzerTestOneInput
- Parsing path: Jsoup.parse -> Parser.parse -> TreeBuilder.runParser -> HtmlTreeBuilder.process
- Target method: HtmlTreeBuilder.popStackToClose(String)
- Plausible inputs are small HTML fragments that build and unwind the parser stack.

Repository context for jansson:
- Driver: LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput in json_load_dump_fuzzer
- The driver feeds JSON text into json_loadb and may later serialize with json_dumps.
- The target is in unicode escape decoding logic inside src/load.c.
- Plausible inputs are compact JSON documents containing escaped characters.
